title: TritonParse Autotune Summary Event
description: Emitted at most once per output file, after all autotune_analysis events, giving a global view of how often each winning config was actually run. Absent entirely when no session produced a winner run.

winner_run_counts.description: Number of autotuning sessions that ran with each winning compilation, keyed by compilation hash. Counts sessions, not launches: a session contributes 1 whether it benchmarked first or reused a cached winner. Only hashes with at least one winner run appear.

occurrence_id.description: Global ordering index across all events.
